faults.quote: Bringing or resulting in good fortune and success.
faults.why: 'Mutlu bir hayat' simply means 'a happy life', not 'fortunate/auspicious'.
'Fortunate' is not a standard meaning of 'mutlu' (which is 'şanslı').
